article.title: “Only Path Forward Is to Abolish”: Outcry After Masked ICE Agents Arrest Family at Seattle Airport
article.content: Washington Governor Bob Ferguson and other officials in the state have denounced the violent arrest of a father and daughter by ICE agents on Saturday as they were boarding a flight at Seattle-Tacoma International Airport. Video of the arrest shows masked plainclothes agents dragging a woman off the jetway as she screams for help. Both Alaska Airlines and the Port of Seattle said ICE carried out the operation without their knowledge. ICE said Ricardo Larrondo Mendoza, originally from Mexico, was targeted for overstaying his tourist visa, and that his daughter, Sofia Hernandez Mejia, would be charged with assault for allegedly throwing hot coffee at an agent — although witnesses dispute that account. “This is one of, unfortunately, many thousands of detentions that is happening not only in Washington state, but across the country,” says Josefina Mora-Cheung, director of organizing for the immigrant justice group La Resistencia. “The only path forward is to abolish ICE .”
